description: E3 + KD from frozen official FP teacher (loss = 0.5 CE + 0.5 KL, T=1, alpha=0 weights) + quant lambda warmup 0->1 over 500 steps. Stopped by us at step 2000 (no gain vs E3_ternary_ft_5k); checkpoint at step 2000 in Drive.
note: Lambda warmup delays rather than avoids the quantization shock: CE rose to 0.52 at lambda=1 (E3 without warmup: 0.484 at step 500). Single seed, 256-puzzle subset (+-3 pt).
